definition: What you could still become. He says a soft life can end before you ever meet it.
example: You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.

definition: Coming to see something clearly. The warning order's loss is dying without ever realizing your potential.
example: You are in danger of living a life so comfortable and soft that you will die without ever realizing your true potential.

definition: Refusing a hard truth. He calls it the ultimate comfort zone.
example: Denial is the ultimate comfort zone.

definition: Ease that keeps you from the truth. Denial, he writes, is the ultimate comfort zone.
example: Denial is the ultimate comfort zone.

definition: A passing urge to act. He says it changes exactly nobody.
example: Motivation changes exactly nobody.

definition: Done by habit, without a fresh decision. He says the self-limiting choices are habitual.
example: But the truth is we all make habitual, self-limiting choices.

definition: Holding yourself under a ceiling you set. He says those choices are habitual.
example: But the truth is we all make habitual, self-limiting choices.

definition: What you are able to do. He says a bold life reaches past what most people consider their capability.
example: Only you can master your mind, which is what it takes to live a bold life filled with accomplishments most people consider beyond their capability.

definition: Something achieved by effort. He ties a bold life to accomplishments most people think are beyond them.
example: Only you can master your mind, which is what it takes to live a bold life filled with accomplishments most people consider beyond their capability.

definition: To refuse to accept a limit. He says the 1 percent will put in the work to defy the odds.
example: There will always be the 1 percent of us who are willing to put in the work to defy the odds.

definition: A built-in limit. He says the mind's governor is buried in identity and stops you early.
example: Our governor is buried deep in our minds, intertwined with our very identity.

definition: Twisted together so the parts are hard to separate. The governor, he writes, is intertwined with identity.
example: Our governor is buried deep in our minds, intertwined with our very identity.

definition: The story of who you are. He says the governor is intertwined with it.
example: Our governor is buried deep in our minds, intertwined with our very identity.

definition: The highest amount available. He says most people quit after about 40 percent of their maximum effort.
example: Sadly, most of us give up when we've only given around 40 percent of our maximum effort.

definition: The work you actually put in. His measure is that most people stop near 40 percent of maximum effort.
example: Sadly, most of us give up when we've only given around 40 percent of our maximum effort.

definition: Total, with nothing left beyond it. He says the feeling of an absolute limit is the governor, and 60 percent remains.
example: Even when we feel like we've reached our absolute limit, we still have 60 percent more to give!

definition: The point where you believe you must stop. He says that feeling still leaves 60 percent more to give.
example: Even when we feel like we've reached our absolute limit, we still have 60 percent more to give!

definition: To harden by repeated strain. The way past 40 percent, he writes, is to callous your mind every day.
example: The only way to move beyond your 40 percent is to callous your mind, day after day.

definition: Worth caring about. He says quitting something meaningful leaves you haunted by it.
example: You can have everything you want in life, but when you quit something that is meaningful to you, you will be haunted by it.

definition: Followed by something you cannot put down. Quitting what matters, he says, leaves you haunted by it.
